analects-03.why: 3.9 杞不足徵也: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 把 (also in Zhu Xi's comment, 把夏之後); Ruan 1816 and He Yan SBCK both have 杞, the state of Qi, heirs of Xia. The sense allows only 杞.

analects-04.why: 4.14 不患莫己知: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 (the copy confuses 己/已/巳 throughout); Zhu Xi's comment on the line has 求其在己者, the first collation witness reads 己, He Yan SBCK has 巳 (its form for both). The sense ('no one knows me') allows only 己.

analects-05.why: 5.9 宰予晝寢: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 宰子 (子/予 confusion; Zhu Xi's comment on the line names 宰予, and the Master goes on 於予與何誅, calling him by his name 予); Ruan 1816 and He Yan SBCK both read 宰予. The sense allows only 宰予.
5.15 其行己也恭: the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 (the copy confuses 己/已/巳, as at 4.14); the first collation witness reads 己. 'In conducting himself' allows only 己.

analects-06.why: 6.28 己欲立而立人，己欲達而達人 'wishing to stand himself, he sets others up; wishing to get through himself, he gets others through': the Kanripo Siku transcription prints 已 for the first 己 and 巳 for the second (the copy confuses 己/已/巳, as at 4.14 and 5.15); Zhu Xi's own comment on the passage quotes 己欲立而立人己欲達而達人, and the first collation witness (KR1h0004) reads 己 both times. The sense allows only 己. One entry covers both characters because the build allows one note-opening per unit.
